rationale: Prior invoice HL-3301 matches on PO, amount and date window, but it carries a distinct service period (2026-02-01/02-28 vs 2026-02-15/03-14), so under clause 8/8.1 this is a legitimate recurring monthly charge, not a duplicate. PO-4422 is a SERVICES PO, so the absence of a goods receipt is not a defect (clause 1); price matches the PO exactly (clause 3) and recomputed tax at 7.5% is $300.00, equal to the billed figure (clause 5). No credit memos; $4,300.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clauses 9-10).
